summary:
Main
Today, the iron ore futures moved steadily today. The most-traded DCE I2609 contract closed at 720.5 yuan/mt, up 0.14% from the previous session.Spot prices at Qingdao Port fell by 0-2 yuan/mt from the previous trading day. Traders mostly priced based on market conditions, while steel mills mainly procured on a rigid demand basis, leaving total spot volumes relatively low so far.
